The evidence is thin and first-party only, and the 'real-time' quality of the exchange is not explicitly described. missing for 10: explicit documentation of real-time or low-latency conversational behavior (e.g., interruption, continuous dialogue), platform availability details for voice mode, independent or hands-on corroboration.
